If you are looking for driving class, aankhe band krke laga lo.

Also, even after classes were done, he didn’t ask for money. It’s me who is behind him asking for hisab so I can pay timely.

Rare are such species in the today’s world.

Thank you both Rajesh uncle and Jay!

Raju Master was assigned as my instructor, and his teaching style is calm, patient, and encouraging, which made the learning process much easier and more comfortable. Within the initial 10 days of training, his guidance helped me gain confidence in driving, and I was able to complete all my scheduled classes successfully.

Overall, it was a smooth and positive learning experience. I would highly recommend Singh Motor Training School to anyone looking to learn driving with confidence and proper guidance.
